CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #3
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Hiding stolen items
   B. Cheating in exams
   C. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   D. Spreading rumours

2. Which response best shows understanding of Journey to Jerusalem Parables on Prayer? (1 mark)
   A. Use Journey to Jerusalem Parables on Prayer to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Journey to Jerusalem Parables on Prayer.
   C. Say Journey to Jerusalem Parables on Prayer has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Journey to Jerusalem Parables on Prayer with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Methods of Studying the Holy Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Say Methods of Studying the Holy Bible has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Methods of Studying the Holy Bible.
   C. Apply the teaching of Methods of Studying the Holy Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Methods of Studying the Holy Bible to insult classmates of other faiths.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Writing the Holy Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Say Writing the Holy Bible has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Writing the Holy Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Writing the Holy Bible to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Writing the Holy Bible.

8. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Refusing to help a neighbour
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Mocking other people’s beliefs
